defaultValue: Choose a difficulty [before] starting a new game so that it applies to every fleet.

fieldDescription: Normal uses the fleet sizes set in the Fleets tab. Easy makes Enigma and scripted fleets smaller. TRUE STARFARER makes them larger and some special encounters harder. Finish the Kesteven questline on TRUE STARFARER, chosen at the start and never changed, to unlock the Hellspawn start.

defaultValue: Changes apply only to fleets that spawn afterwards. These sizes are used on Normal difficulty only.

fieldDescription: Size multiplier for scripted event and quest fleets. Scales only the randomly generated part of each fleet.
Size multiplier for wandering Enigma fleets. Set to 0 to stop them from spawning.

defaultValue: Finishing the Kesteven questline turns these on for all later games. The Hellspawn start also needs TRUE STARFARER difficulty.

fieldDescription: Makes the Throne's Gift background selectable when you start a new game with Nexerelin.
Makes the Hellspawn background selectable when you start a new game with Nexerelin.
Offers a story point option to skip ahead in the Kesteven questline.
When you pilot a ship with the Stasis Generator system, pressing this key while the system is cooling down fires the charged stasis sphere. Set it to your ship system key to use one key for both.
